review.verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=incremental below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The proved substantive core is an exact transport-polytope image for a deliberately free selector class, a standard parametric-LP directional derivative, and pointwise numerical-delta inference; this is useful but narrow and largely assembles established coupling and directional-delta machinery. The new zero-coverage theorem concerns a specially constructed collapsing-response singleton and an estimator whose negligible root-n bias dominates a vanishing sampling distribution, so it does not establish the advertised rare-margin frontier or any general inferential impossibility. The note repeatedly says that an effective-support alternating-cycle point-identification criterion is retained, but no such proposition or proof appears in the delivered theorem text, and the claimed endpoint min/max-flow certification is likewise not formally delivered beyond generic LP attainment. Uniform validity on the response-interior class, comparative width, the proposed cubic margin threshold, and the substantive PDX application all remain open, leaving the package below a field-level contribution and limiting its leading-journal score. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 5.2 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]

HALTED AT TRIAGE: the math panel returned `revise` and its findings were never repaired, so this note is NOT established as mathematically sound — do not bank it as downgraded on this verdict alone.
